source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/13-admin.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p13"; README screen 13
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell + the real AdminDashboard (its own internal Masthead), populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-admin'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

Artboard order: Masthead -> 8-tile stat grid (Workspaces/Sources/Ingest/Coverage/Research pipeline/Community pickups/Runtime/Emission factors), Sources tile SELECTED (bordered, no shadow) -> breadcrumb strip ('Admin / <selected section>') -> Sources sub-tab bar, 'Provisional review' FIRST and active -> the provisional-review table -> Organizations section -> rail: Issues queue, Companies/Individuals/Newest join/Active this month tiles, read-only-controls note.

This lane fixed three real defects: (1) AdminDashboard defaulted to Workspaces/Organizations, not the artboard's default Sources/Provisional-review landing state — fixed by changing the initial section/sub state. (2) The Sources tab order was [Source registry, Provisional review, ...]; dc.html p13 lists Provisional review first — reordered. Also wired AdminDashboard to sync SourceHealthDashboard's own internal `activeView` (a zustand-store field the component never previously received from its caller, despite AdminDashboard's own comment claiming 'the sub-tab scopes the operator's intent') so picking 'Provisional review' actually opens SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional tab instead of always landing on Registry. (3) An ORGANIZATIONS card (PlateCard + OrganizationsTable) used to render ONLY under the Workspaces section — dc.html p13's own Sources/Provisional-review default view shows it stacked directly below the Sources table too; added a second render site in the Sources branch (same components, not a fork). This was caught only after a capture-script fix (see the next note) revealed the true render — this spec's region-3 check used to false-positive-match the WORKSPACES tile's own description text ('Organizations, members, invitations...'), which is present regardless, masking the missing card entirely; region 3 below now selects the actual `ORGANIZATIONS` card heading, not any element containing the word.

capture-compose-page.mjs fix (lane compose-other, 2026-09-08): AppShell's frame is `height:100vh` with its OWN internal scroll — the document body never grows past the viewport, so the capture script's original `page.screenshot({fullPage:true})` silently truncated any mount whose real content exceeds the 1400px viewport (Playwright's fullPage measures body scroll height, which never changes here). This admin mount's real content is 1665px tall; the truncated first capture cut off the Organizations card entirely, and the region-3 spec check below happened to still pass by matching stray 'Organizations' text elsewhere on the visible (truncated) page — a screenshot bug masking a real composition bug. Fixed the capture script to measure the mounted `[data-audit]` element's actual height and grow the viewport to fit before shooting (no longer `fullPage`, since the grown viewport already contains everything).

NOT FIXED, logged instead (DEVIATION-LOG 2026-09-08): SourceHealthDashboard itself — the component the Provisional-review tab renders — is a much larger, differently-composed surface than dc.html p13's simple 'SOURCES · PROVISIONAL REVIEW' table (SOURCE/TIER/STATUS/DISCOVERED columns, one Approve button per row). The shipped component renders its own 'Source Intelligence' header, a B.2 regeneration-progress bar, a Source Tiers legend block, a T1-T7 tile grid, and its own second Registry/Health/Provisional/Canonical/Intersections/Themes/Obligations tab bar — none of which the artboard shows for this region. Rebuilding SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional view to match the artboard is a component-level effort (the surface is shared beyond this one entry point) out of this page-composition pass's reach; this spec does not assert a fabricated match for that region's content, only for what the mount actually renders identically to the artboard (masthead, tile grid, tab selection/order, Organizations section, rail).
OrganizationsTable — no artboard region (fix58-account's own 2026-09-07 DEVIATION-LOG entry already established this; unaudited, left as-is, listed again here for this lane's own record).
